name: praxis
description: Independent engineering workflows for design, durable work, execution, review, verification, Git delivery, and continuity.

interface.longDescription: Praxis provides focused, activity-named techniques for design, specifications, decisions, plans, execution, issues, queues, programs, debugging, collaboration, review, verification, documentation, worktrees, commits, pull requests, risky operations, handoff, and optional continuity. Clear implementation and ordinary Git outcomes need no generic lifecycle skill, and durable artifacts are created only when their own trigger is present.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Praxis skill that directly names this activity; use praxis:using-praxis only when the route is unclear.
